chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It is befitting for the performer of Tamattu' that he should visit the House (the Kaaba) on the Day of Sacrifice, or from its night, and he should not delay that.

key_terms.لِلْمُتَمَتِّعِ: For the performer of Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِ: From its night (the night preceding the Day of Sacrifice)
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: When should a Mu'tamatti perform the circumambulation of the Kaaba during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies that the circumambulation (Tawaf) for the Mutamatti' should be performed on the Day of Sacrifice or its night, emphasizing promptness to align with the ritual sequence. Scholarly tradition views this as a key distinction in Shia fiqh, ensuring the pilgrim completes the Hajj pillars in their prescribed order before proceeding to other rites. The instruction underscores the importance of not delaying this specific act of worship to maintain the integrity of the Hajj ritual cycle.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is befitting for the performer of Tumatto that he should visit the House (Kabah) on the day of the sacrifice, or from that night of his, and he should not delay that’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

It is very proper that one for al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) visits the House on the day of al-Nahr (slaughtering the offering, 10th of Dhu al- Hajjah) or during this night and must not delay. ‘“(Fatwa best explains Hadith 1-3 of this Chapter)
